claim_boundary: Descriptive topology audit only. Column-to-column structural matrices can constrain a later mechanistic model, but they do not establish wind tuning, goal angle, effective connectivity, physiological sign, or behavioral steering direction.

PFL3 instance L/R labels are reported verbatim and are not promoted to motor side; candidate steering roles remain derived from exact DNa02 connectivity.
Missing column labels remain missing; they are not imputed from soma side, body ID, or downstream performance.
No directional role is selected from this audit using behavioral performance.
